name: Wish-Ender

frame.name: Queen's Wrath
frame.description: While aiming down sights with a fully drawn Bow, combatants behind walls are highlighted and arrows pierce shields. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

perks.name: High Tension String
perks.description:
Tightly strung bow.
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly slower draw time
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Anti-Taken Fletching
perks.description:
Specialized to fight Taken targets.
  •  Increases accuracy

perks.name: Broadhead
perks.description: Piercing arrowhead that damages the target on entry and exit. One shot can overpenetrate multiple targets.

flavor: "Don't fret. It's a simple expedition. We'll be back before lunch." —Sjur Eido, First Queen's Wrath

catalyst.name: Wish-Ender Catalyst
catalyst.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.
